novel_features.name: Period-over-period performance
novel_features.description: See whether impressions, saves, and outbound clicks grew versus the previous equal-length period, with absolute and percent deltas.
novel_features.rationale: Pairs two analytics windows and computes deltas that no single Pinterest endpoint returns.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this for a weekly or monthly 'did we grow?' answer instead of calling account analytics twice and doing date math.

novel_features.name: Pin hygiene audit
novel_features.description: Find published Pins missing alt text, a destination link, a title, or UTM tracking, grouped by board. Reads the local store; run sync first.
novel_features.rationale: Joins synced Pins and boards in the local store; the API has no inventory-wide quality view.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before an SEO cleanup pass to get the exact Pin IDs that need fixing.

novel_features.name: Pin preflight
novel_features.description: Validate a proposed Pin (field limits, board and section by name, UTM link) and get a ready-to-send create body without writing anything. Board names resolve from the local store; run sync first.
novel_features.rationale: Combines spec field limits with board/section name resolution from the local store, entirely offline.
novel_features.example: pinterest-pp-cli pins preflight --board "Recipes" --link https://example.com/blog/meal-prep?utm_source=pinterest --image-url https://example.com/img/meal-prep.jpg --title "Weeknight dinner ideas" --alt-text "Bowl of pasta on a table" --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before pins create so an agent never publishes an incomplete or misrouted Pin.

novel_features.name: Save to outbound-click funnel
novel_features.description: Rank your top Pins by impressions (or --sort-by metric), compute save and outbound-click rates, and flag Pins that get saved but don't send traffic.
novel_features.rationale: Computes per-Pin rates and quartile flags from top-Pin analytics that Pinterest returns as raw counts.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to decide which Pins to refresh or repurpose to drive site traffic.

novel_features.name: Trend content gaps
novel_features.description: List trending keywords for a region with how many of your synced Pins cover each, zero-coverage first. Coverage counts need a synced local store.
novel_features.rationale: Joins live trending keywords with full-text search over your synced Pins.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when planning the next content batch to find trends you have nothing on.

novel_features.name: One-shot ads report
novel_features.description: Create, wait for, and download an ads performance report in one command. Requires the ads:read scope and --ad-account-id (or PINTEREST_AD_ACCOUNT_ID).
novel_features.rationale: Collapses Pinterest's async report create, poll, and download steps.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for campaign or ad performance instead of manually polling the async report endpoint.

narrative.headline: Every Pinterest v5 endpoint plus period-over-period analytics, Pin hygiene audits, and offline Pin search.
narrative.value_prop: Covers boards, Pins, analytics, trends, ads, catalogs, and audiences from one binary with --dry-run on writes, no interactive prompts, and explicit --yes confirmation. A bounded local sync powers offline search, the 'pins audit' hygiene report, and 'trends gaps'; 'perf compare' and 'pins funnel' turn raw analytics into answers.
narrative.auth_narrative: Pinterest uses OAuth 2.0 authorization code. Run 'pinterest-pp-cli auth login' with PINTEREST_CLIENT_ID and PINTEREST_CLIENT_SECRET set; the redirect URI must exactly match the one registered on your Pinterest app (for example http://localhost:8875/callback). Token exchange and refresh authenticate the app with HTTP Basic, and continuous refresh keeps access alive. For one-off runs, export a current access token as PINTEREST_ACCESS_TOKEN (PINTEREST_OAUTH2 is also accepted).

quickstart.comment: Confirm the binary and command tree are installed (no network); run plain 'doctor' to check auth and the API
Confirm which Pinterest account the token belongs to
Pull your boards, sections, and Pins into the local store (bounded by default)
Find Pins missing alt text, links, titles, or UTM tags
See this month versus last month

troubleshoots.fix: Run pinterest-pp-cli auth status; if the refresh token expired, re-run pinterest-pp-cli auth login
Pass the exact registered callback, e.g. pinterest-pp-cli auth login --port 8875

troubleshoots.symptom: 429 Too Many Requests on trial access
troubleshoots.fix: Trial apps are capped at 1000 requests/day; use the local store (search, pins audit) and sync with --max-pages

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI to inspect or operate a Pinterest business account: boards, Pins, organic analytics, trends, and ads. It is the right tool for weekly performance reviews, Pin SEO cleanup, safe pre-publish validation, and ads reporting.
anti_triggers: Scraping other people's public Pinterest profiles or boards without OAuth
Designing Pin images or generating Pin copy (use a design or writing tool)
Bulk mutation of live Pins without explicit human approval
